description: Saves one allocation pick of the customer: keep an item as separate property after the wedding, or share it (allocation_labels of get_alignment give the words of the app). kind asset is an own premarital asset that is not shared (get_alignment step premarital-property). kind marital_property is a category of postmarital property (get_alignment step postmarital-property). After the financial philosophy quiz closed, a pick of kind marital_property needs the step postmarital-property. An allocation question of the financial philosophy quiz gives the items of both kinds. A pick of a postmarital category asks the partner to review it again. Read module_state before the pick. When it is edit_restarts_alignment, tell the customer that the pick restarts the alignment of the couple and can email the partner, and get a yes. Send the module_state that you read as expected_module_state, also when it is open. After an asset, family, or allocation write, tell the customer that the alignment restarted when alignment_restarted is true. Tell the customer that the partner got an email when partner_emailed is true. When a value is false, say nothing about it. When the customer asks about these values, answer from the results of all the writes in this conversation.

expected_module_state.description: The module_state that you read for this kind. When the state is now different, the tool saves nothing and gives the new state.

id.description: The id of the asset or of the postmarital category.

separate_property.description: True to keep the item separate. False to share it.

name: set_allocation

alignment_restarted.description: True when the write restarted the alignment of the couple.

partner_emailed.description: True when the partner got an email that the alignment restarted.

title: Set an allocation
